$comment: Golden response-shape contract for the dtc feature. Each named field MUST appear as a literal in the firmware source that builds the cJSON response (verified by eval.sh). Inline-documented at the top of dtc_commands.c.

required_fields_in_data.ok: bool — true on success, false on failure
required_fields_in_data.codes: array — present iff ok=true; each entry has code, status, description

$note: P-54 (ClearDTC NRC 0x11) is owner-held; the dtc_clear response shape stays in this golden contract even though wire behavior is still being investigated. The shape doesn't depend on the wire fix.
